question: In which of the following sports/games is the term 'bull's eye' used?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shooting**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term **'bull's eye'** is primarily used in the sport of **shooting**.
 
• In shooting, a bull's eye refers to the center of a target and is the area that scores the highest points when hit.
 
• The term is also used in other target-based sports such as **archery and darts**, but it is most commonly associated with shooting.
 
• Achieving a bull's eye is often considered a mark of precision and skill in the sport.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shooting** is a competitive sport involving tests of proficiency (**accuracy and speed**) using various types of guns such as firearms and airguns.
 
• It is one of the oldest sports and has been a part of the Olympic Games since the **first modern Olympics in 1896**.
 
• There are multiple disciplines within shooting sports, including rifle, pistol, and shotgun events.
 
• Safety is paramount in shooting sports, and participants must adhere to strict safety guidelines and regulations.
